annotations.title: List the models, jobs and listings on offer

description: Lists every module this server sells (chat model router, paid jobs, seller listings) with its path, MCP tool name, price, unit, params and whether it is available now. Free; no input. Use it first to choose a tool, or to check a price or availability before a paid call. Use chat instead to run a model. Auth: none. Read-only; it has no error states of its own.
name: catalogue
